name: Residences of the Royal House of Savoy
description: This World Heritage site is a network of royal palaces, country residences and hunting lodges in and around Turin, in Italy's Piedmont region. The Dukes of Savoy began building it after making Turin their capital in 1562. At its heart is the Royal Palace, and the other buildings spread outward into the countryside. Leading architects and artists of the day designed and decorated them to show off the dynasty's power.
